annotations.title: Fetch a Cobalt study or review as text

description: Fetch the full text of a Cobalt study by the id search returned, or of any Cobalt review by its URL (/r/<slug>) or slug. Returns text: findings, prices, the comparison matrix, and the underlying review's notes with links to its screenshots. Use get_review instead when you need to see the screenshots as images.

id.description: An id from search (e.g. 'teardown:canva'), or a review URL or slug.

name: fetch
